name: codex-lark-remote
description: Control, observe, and take over local Codex sessions from Feishu/Lark.

interface.shortDescription: Control, observe, and take over Codex sessions from Feishu/Lark.
interface.longDescription: Lark Remote connects Feishu/Lark to a local Codex bridge. Use the natural-language console to list projects and sessions, observe read-only progress, or take over a selected Codex session. After takeover, Feishu/Lark messages go to the dedicated Codex control window, where the agent uses skills, MCP tools, and host thread tools to decide the next action.
defaultPrompt: Start Lark Remote for this Codex workspace
Configure Lark Remote with my Feishu/Lark app credentials
